mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which can potentiate CNS depression from lorazepam and increase seizure risk; both drugs also increase CNS depression additively.
action: Monitor renal function and electrolytes closely; assess CNS depression; consider dose adjustment of lorazepam if significant renal impairment develops; maintain adequate electrolyte supplementation.
